scope: Isolated Windows offline package and original Continue/Save buttons. The viewport receives mouse and keyboard events, including the rebound Stop key. The controlled fixture tests the gate and path boundaries with actors frozen. The historical checkpoint was saved after an actual assault with Lu Junyi already evacuated. Completion advances at four times speed.
